headline: Self-employment of 14.3 % is the distinctive feature; full-time work is a little below the benchmarks.
how_to_read: Flows run from all respondents (left) to employed or not employed (middle) and then to detailed situation (right); width is the share of respondents. Both branch totals are hidden, so branches show as lower bounds (≥) and a hatched "Hidden" flow leaves "Respondents" directly.
key_findings: Full-time work accounts for 71.4 % and self-employment for 14.3 % of respondents.
Nobody reports not seeking work, studying, retirement or another situation; the remaining categories are hidden (fewer than 3 people).
benchmark: Self-employment is 5.1 pp above Asia (9.2 %) and 6.3 pp above all schools (8.0 %). Full-time work is 3.2 pp below Asia (74.6 %) and 3.5 pp below all schools (74.9 %).
caveats: With n = 21, each person moves the percentages by several points, and both totals are hidden.
